# promptologia provenance

The prompts under `prompts/promptologia/` are adapted from the executable prompt
artifacts in [DevComputaria/promptologia](https://github.com/DevComputaria/promptologia).

- Upstream commit: `4c45710dc2be5c1b2ea7d43ced62f7501629ce10`
- Imported scope: the ten non-README Markdown files under `grimorio/artefatos/`
- Adaptations: normalized prompt IDs and variables, split system/user roles,
  security-sensitive variable annotations, deterministic output requirements, and
  minor wording changes required by this repository's runtime contract.
- License: the upstream DBUAITR license, reproduced in
  `licenses/promptologia-LICENSE.txt`.

The original copyright and permission notice apply to these adapted prompts.
